title: Queued data
use: Transfer each accepted value through a bounded queue.
cardinality: Each connected receiver has exactly one source. A sender may feed multiple receivers.
constraint: Queue overflow follows the connector policy. Queued does not mean lossless delivery.

title: Sampled data
cardinality: Each connected receiver has exactly one source. A sender may feed multiple receivers.
constraint: Sampled members require capacity 1 and dropOldest. Freshness and latency bounds are explicit.

title: Request / response
use: Invoke a typed function and await its correlated result.
cardinality: Each connected client has exactly one server. A server may serve multiple clients.
constraint: Every request has a timeout and terminal failure branch. This atLeastOnce route requires idempotent functions.

title: Event publication
use: Publish typed notifications over explicit subscriptions.
cardinality: Publishers may fan out. Subscribers may receive from multiple publishers through distinct connectors.
constraint: Each incoming event has one handler owner. atLeastOnce can cause duplicate dispatch; handlers must account for it.

title: Service contract
use: Combine callable functions and provider notifications in one contract.
cardinality: Each connected requires port has exactly one provider. A provides port may serve multiple consumers.
constraint: Requests travel to the provider; replies and events return through the same route. Events remain distinct from results.
